name: YFG Smorgasbord [Flux]
description: YFG Smorgasbord: Versatile Detail Enhancer YFG Smorgasbord is a LoRA designed to enrich virtually any prompt or scene with intricate, sometimes surreal additions. Trained on a broad assortment of images, it can yield results ranging from subtle enhancements to full-fledged, highly detailed transformations—depending on your chosen LoRA strength and prompt style. Key Features Multi-Genre Adaptation Effectively adds variety and depth to scenes, regardless of genre—fantasy, sci-fi, portrait, architecture, etc. Not restricted to a single visual style or subject matter. Detail-Oriented Infuses prompts with extra flourishes, complex textures, and possibly surreal elements. Functions as a “detail booster” to elevate the basic Flux model outputs. Flexible Intensity Typically used around 0.8 strength. Push to 1.0 for maximal transformation and high detail. Go as low as 0.4 for subtler refinements—especially when stacking with other LoRAs. Surreal Possibilities Introduces odd or dreamlike qualities when prompts don’t constrain the direction. Encourages creativity in prompts, revealing unexpected visual twists. Recommended Usage Trigger / Prompt Word Use “YFG-Sm0rg” if you want to really draw upon this LoRA’s eclectic influences, though not strictly necessary. LoRA Strength Guidelines 0.4 for subtle detail enhancement. 0.8 for a balanced infusion of complexity. 1.0 for a strong, potentially surreal impact. Example Prompts & Themes “A fantasy cityscape in twilight, infused with YFG-Sm0rg detailing.” “YFG-Sm0rg sci-fi laboratory scene with swirling neon elements.” Pair with complementary LoRAs like painting styles, character designs, or architectural aesthetics. Tips & Tricks Direct the Details If you want certain types of detail (e.g., floral patterns, mechanical textures, swirling lights), include them in your prompt. Otherwise, the LoRA may add surprising—but sometimes random—surreal elements. Combining LoRAs Start with a 0.5 strength for YFG Smorgasbord and adjust to taste if mixing with other strong LoRAs. Keep an eye on over-saturation or clashing styles when multiple LoRAs influence the output. Use Negative Prompts When Needed If the LoRA introduces details you don’t want (like random text or overly busy patterns), add them to negative prompts for cleaner results. Experiment With Lighting & Color YFG Smorgasbord can amplify color palettes or lighting cues, so testing different descriptions of ambience, mood, or color temperature can lead to stunning variations. YFG Smorgasbord opens up a world of artistic exploration—layering your scenes with intriguing textures and unexpected details. Whether you seek a gentle aesthetic boost or a surrealistic flourish, this LoRA adapts to your prompt, turning simple setups into dynamic visual feasts!
